verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an open-source migration tool that imports users from JSON/CSV via the Backend API (clerk-docs-7, clerk-supp-migration-tool), covering the bulk-import half of the story, but the evidence never mentions preserving/importing password hashes specifically, nor any official export tool or process for getting users back out of Clerk. Missing for 10: explicit password-hash import support, an official export/data-portability tool, and confirmation of round-trip migration to avoid lock-in.
